metrics.normalization: whole-note RMS 0.1, no frame normalization or time warp
metrics.loss: 0.3 attack + 0.3 body + 0.4 tail log-mel L1, mean of resolutions
metrics.preprocessing: causal second-order 30 Hz highpass on both signals before whole-note RMS
metrics.secondary: 20 ms RMS-envelope L1 in dB; absolute 90%-energy-time error in seconds
